description:
Counts the working days between two dates, or adds a number of working days to a start date, for any of the 16 German federal states with that state's public holidays (rules as of 2026-08-15). Intended for requests where the user asks how many working days lie between two dates or which date is n working days after a start date. Two modes: add (start + n working days → end date) and count (date range → number of working days). Not for procurement-law deadlines, which count calendar days under Regulation 1182/71; calculate_tender_deadline calculates those.

Example user questions: "Wie viele Werktage liegen zwischen zwei Terminen?"; "Wann ist der 10. Werktag nach dem 05.10.2026 in Bayern?"; "Arbeitstage zwischen zwei Daten in NRW"; "Frist in Werktagen berechnen"; "Wie viele Arbeitstage hat der Oktober in Berlin?"

bis.description: End of date range for mode=count (inclusive).

land.description: 2-letter German federal state code: BW=Baden-Württemberg, BY=Bayern, BE=Berlin, BB=Brandenburg, HB=Bremen, HH=Hamburg, HE=Hessen, MV=Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, NI=Niedersachsen, NW=Nordrhein-Westfalen, RP=Rheinland-Pfalz, SL=Saarland, SN=Sachsen, ST=Sachsen-Anhalt, SH=Schleswig-Holstein, TH=Thüringen.

mode.description: add: start + n working days → end date. count: count working days between von and bis.

samstag.description: Count Saturday as a working day (for trade-law or rent-law deadlines). Default: false.

start.description: Start date for mode=add (ISO or German format).

tage.description: Number of working days to add (positive = forward, negative = backward) for mode=add.

von.description: Start of date range for mode=count.

name: count_working_days
title: Werktage berechnen
